messages:
marta (People Ops): Heads-up: we've published a targeted handbook update and a short manager microtraining around mental health leave and caregiver accommodations. Key items: clarified intermittent leave handling, new manager checklist for accommodations, and a required 12-minute micro-module for managers titled 'Inclusive Reasonable Accommodations'. Deadline for manager confirmations: 2026-10-12. Link: https://go.redwood/hr/mh-caregiver-update2026

ray (People Ops): TL;DR: Employees should review the handbook blurb; managers must complete the 12-min module and mark the Manager Confirmations column in the tracker. We added a new "Accommodation Request" workflow link and intake form.

juna (Legal): Legal: updated language clarifies confidentiality, documentation expectations, and reasonable timeline guidance. If your country requires specific statutory language, pick the local variant listed in the doc and add a one-line note in the tracker for audit.

oliver (Benefits): Benefits note: if an accommodation includes a stipend or temporary schedule change that impacts payroll, flag it in the payroll column so Benefits can coordinate. We prefilled likely payroll-impact cases; managers should verify.

tara (EM): Quick Q — do managers need to complete training if they already did the general accommodations legal course last year?

marta (People Ops): If you completed 'Accommodations 101' in the last 9 months and your completion is in the HRIS, you’re exempt. Otherwise please do the new 12-min module; it focuses on process changes and the updated checklist.

leo (People Ops): Ops note: I will drop per-manager CSV exports into `ack_exports/2101234567_manager_csvs.zip` within the hour. Managers: the sheet has a Manager Confirmations column and an "Audit note" column for any manual changes.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-09-28T16:00Z — autopulse to managers who haven't started the module.

marta (People Ops): Manager checklist: 1) Review handbook diff; 2) complete 'Inclusive Reasonable Accommodations' module by 2026-10-12; 3) confirm completions in the tracker; 4) use the Accommodation Request intake form for any new cases; 5) add short audit notes for manual edits.

tara (EM): Can you give a short blurb I can post in my engineering channel? I want something concise and respectful of privacy.

ray (People Ops): Use this copy: `Reminder: Handbook update on mental health leave and caregiver accommodations. Managers: please complete the 12-minute accommodations micro-module and confirm in the tracker by Oct 12. Employees: review the handbook blurb and use the intake form for accommodations.`

juna (Legal): One more legal reminder: do not include sensitive medical details in comments. Use HR case IDs or secure ticket links when referencing medical documentation.

oliver (Benefits): If you spot a payroll-impact case that was missed in the prefill, mark it as 'Needs Payroll Review' in the tracker and cc benefits@redwood.com. Payroll will batch any fixes in the Oct 30 run if confirmed by the deadline.

leo (People Ops): Uploaded the per-manager CSVs to the People Ops folder: `ack_exports/2101234567_manager_csvs.zip`. If you need a contractor-only slice or a custom filter, DM me.

marta (People Ops): Action recap: managers = complete module and confirm by 2026-10-12; verify payroll-impact prefill; add audit notes for manual changes; contact people-ops@redwood.com for exceptions. We'll post this summary in #announcements after translations and CSV uploads. :white_check_mark:
